title: Ability to manually create groups in task manager
line: The task manager's Group setting has a new "Manually" option: drop a window's task on the middle of another task to put them in one group.
explanation: The task manager could only group tasks automatically by the program backing them (or not at all), so there was no way to collect windows of different programs into one group, which Plasma 4 allowed. libtaskmanager now has a GroupManual mode: groups are remembered per window id, so a grouped window that is hidden (other desktop or activity) rejoins its group when it comes back, and groups dissolve when only one window is left. The task manager offers it as Group: "Manually"; dropping a window task on the middle half of another one groups them (dragging past it still reorders), and the More menu has "Ungroup" for a group and "Remove from Group" for a member.

commits.message:
libtaskmanager: add a manual group mode

Tasks could only be grouped by the program backing them, so windows of
different programs could never share a group. The new GroupManual mode
only groups tasks when asked to through the new request methods.

BUG: 387835

applets/taskmanager: allow grouping tasks manually

The Group setting only offered grouping by program name. A new Manually
option groups a window with another one when it is dropped on the middle
of that task, and the context menu can take it out of the group again.

BUG: 387835
